rows.en: Would you quit calling me 'princess' already...
Why not... Beauty is justice, you know?

Tch.
I'm going on ahead...
Then I'll be heading off too...
Huh? Wait...?

And you and I will get muuuch closer,
won't we...
rows.notes: Bobby to the player, left alone with him.

rows.en:
(...The tea was good, but I'm totally
exhausted...)

S-sorry!
I've got something to do after this!
See you later, Alto, Michel!
Ah, hey!
Quick to run off, that one...
rows.notes: Shared row; neutral for the player.

rows.en: Aww! Oh, come ON!!
(Who knows what he would've done to me!)

Hey, Saotome-kun.
Let's go to S.M.S.
Michel-kun, you come too!

Oh my, if it isn't a whole lineup of hunks
and a pretty girl...!
(...The tea was good, but I'm so tired...)
See you later, Saotome-kun, Michel-kun!

(Ugh, my skin's such a mess...
And now I've got a zit...)

(Maybe I'll pick up some face wash and
ointment on the way home...)

...Oh dear, oh dear, getting pimples...
You're ruining that cute skin of yours...
B-Bobby-san, when did you get here...

\p-chan...
Make a face like that and your luck will
run away from you.
Uh-huh...

Honestly, you really don't take care of
yourself, do you... Are you getting plenty
of sleep?
12 hours of sleep
Just under 5 hours
...I sleep about 12 hours.
You tell lies so smoothly, don't you...

Listen, I'm going to explain why skin care
from your teens on is so important.
Pay attention!
U-uh, okay...
Put some spirit into it!!
Yesss!!

...and that's how it works...
Got it?
Zzz...
Whaddaya think you're sleepin' for, punk!!
rows.notes: Bobby snaps into rough thug speech (nani neton no ja ware); kept at full force.

rows.en:
Wha-!
I-I was listening!
About 5 hours, I guess.

OUT!!
Get 10 hours.
I can't fall asleep that early.

It's all for the sake of beauty.
Beauty wasn't built in a day, you know!
rows.notes: Pun on 'Rome wasn't built in a day', set up for c00567.

rows.en:
I feel like I've heard that phrase
somewhere before...

Phew... Oh, never mind...
Anyway, use this face soap.
Bye now~
(...Where did he even pull that soap from...)

(Ugh, my skin's such a mess...
And now I've got a pimple...)
(Huh? Is that who I think it is...?)
rows.notes: x30, generic 'the one over there is...'.

rows.en: Claire-senpaaai!

Why, \p-kun.
Good day to you.
rows.notes: Male version. gokigenyou = posh greeting, set up for c00575.

rows.en: G-'good day'? Senpai...
What is it~?
No, nothing...

(I've never seen anyone actually say
'good day' before...)

What a funny kid... Anyway, are you free
right now?

Then how about tea at Silver Moon?
Your big sis is treating.

Huh!?
Are you sure?

I asked Yuu, but she said she was busy.
Sorry you're only the stand-in, but if you're
free, come have tea with your big sis.
Absolutely, I'd love to!!
Okay then, let's gooo~!
rows.notes: rettsu go~ written in hiragana: cutesy.

rows.en: ('Let's gooo~!'...?)
Hup... there we go.
rows.notes: yokkoisho: old-sounding grunt as she sits; feeds the age joke.

rows.en: Nothing beats a milk tea after a nice walk.
Senpai...
What is it? Munch munch.
Senpai, how old are you again?
...You're asking a lady her age?
N-no, I was just curious.

I'm wearing a uniform, so you can tell,
can't you? Asking just because you're
curious... How rude.

U-uh...
Well, I guess so, but...
Hmph, hmph!
('Hmph, hmph'... huh...)
Thanks for the treat today.
Not at all, you're welcome.
Well then, let's hang out again!
(Just how old is Claire-senpai, really...)

Why, \p-chan.
Good day to you.

(I've never seen anyone actually say
'good day' before, wow...)
Oh, absolutely, yes!!
Milk tea after a walk really hits the spot.
Senpai, how old are you again?
rows.notes: Female version; same English as c00590.

uncertain: c00561: Bobby's sudden thug speech (ware) rendered 'Whaddaya think you're sleepin' for, punk!!'.
c00566: bi no michi wa ichinichi ni shite narazu (pun on 'Rome was not built in a day') rendered 'Beauty wasn't built in a day' so c00567 still lands.
c00586: yokkoisho rendered 'Hup... there we go.'; the old-person flavour (which feeds the age joke) is only partly carried.
